about: The outpatient note identifies modified-release morphine as the first opioid for this fracture pain, and the supply confirms the formulation.
possible finding: the record holds no line about the cause of the pain or when opioid treatment for this episode began, although modified-release morphine was supplied.
The fracture course began with Oxyndone before the switch to modified-release morphine, and the later first opioid for a separate episode treated cancer-related pain.
